triples.subject: Alexey Fyodorovitch
triples.quote: he remembered that his father had insisted the day before that he should come without his brother Ivan seeing him.

triples.subject: Fyodor Pavlovitch Karamazov
triples.quote: So I am saving up more and more, simply for myself, my dear son Alexey Fyodorovitch.

triples.subject: Fyodor Pavlovitch Karamazov
triples.quote: even now the law does not allow you to drag your old father about by the hair, to kick him in the face in his own house

triples.subject: Mitya
triples.quote: even now the law does not allow you to drag your old father about by the hair, to kick him in the face in his own house, and brag of murdering him outright—all in the presence of witnesses.

triples.subject: Mitya
triples.quote: Is that betrothed of his, Katerina Ivanovna, whom he has kept so carefully hidden from me all this time, going to marry him or not?

triples.subject: Ivan Fyodorovitch
triples.quote: He is doing his utmost to carry off Mitya’s betrothed. That’s what he is staying here for

triples.subject: Katerina Ivanovna
triples.quote: There you see how dearly these fine young ladies love a rake and a scoundrel.

triples.subject: Smerdyakov
triples.quote: He was quite alone in the house, for Smerdyakov too had gone out marketing.
